notes.title: Booking.com Room & Hotel Photo Scan (DOM-based)
notes.text:
Room Scan on booking.com now collects real room/hotel photos directly from the page DOM:
- Handles native booking.com rooms (bstatic CDN) and Partner Offer / wholesaler rooms (agoda CDN) on the same page
- Reuses the property's own photo gallery (with per-room filter tabs) when available, instead of reopening it for every room
- Falls back to each room's own inline photo popup when there is no filter-tab gallery
- Upgrades thumbnail URLs to higher resolution and de-duplicates photos

notes.title: Multiple Bedrooms Autofill Edit Option
notes.text:
Now you can edit the room option before adding to tera
- Clicks Multiple Bedrooms radio first before filling each bedroom
- Detects and removes extra empty bedroom sections automatically
